summary: Comprehensive revised implementation plan aligning Sanity Studio navigation and page models directly with the website's navigation bar (Home, Proof, Pricing, About me, Blog, Free tools, Newsletter, Contact/Work with me). Provides a non-technical friendly Elementor-style visual section builder with drag-and-drop reordering, deletion, and addition of media, video, and text blocks, alongside rich collections for Blog, Proof, and Free Resources. Preserves 100% of existing styling, colors, and typography.
